title: Bound and constrain atomic-vector recovery journals
description: test/vectors/atomic_json.py reads the recovery journal without a byte/entry bound and accepts arbitrary same-directory basenames for target, temporary, and backup. A corrupt/tampered prepared journal can consume unbounded resources or copy an arbitrary repository file over another target during rollback. Cap journal bytes/entries, require module-owned preparation names (and target-correlated names) for temp/backup, reject symlink/nonregular journal/artifacts, and add malicious-journal regressions.
